Green Economy Research and Development Institute (GREECO) - A leader in green technology transfer, circular economy and climate action.

The Green Economy Research and Development Institute (GREECO) is a science and technology organization researching, applying and transferring sustainable development, green economy and environmental technology solutions. Our multidisciplinary experts in chemical and environmental engineering, renewable energy, remote sensing, geotechnics and sustainability management connect scientific research with practical needs to serve businesses, communities and regulators.
The Green Economy Research and Development Institute (GREECO) specializes in research, consulting and technology transfer for sustainable development, the circular economy and climate action.
